blocks.text: The hill side is forced into humiliation when the Singh’s strength cannot be overcome, and the scene is explicitly compared to Angad’s immovable foot in the older sacred tradition.
One after another the challengers fail, touch the Singh’s feet, and watch their confidence collapse before the fixed sign of power.
Angad becomes the interpretive key here: the Khalsa challenge is presented as standing in continuity with older Guru authority, not merely raw force.
